acquisition_method.evidence: The peptides were desalted using a C18 resin and measured using SWATH-MS on a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer equipped with an Waters Aquity M-Class UPLC System.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The samples were reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin in denaturing conditions.
This was followed by a 5 minute limited proteolysis step in which proteinase K was added.
